title: LociArt: A Unified Paradigm for Free-Style Local Video Stylization
abstract: arXiv:2610.36456v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video stylization typically transforms entire scenes, while local artistic editing requires precise region--style association, spatial control, and temporal consistency. We introduce LociArt, a unified paradigm for free-style local video stylization that explicitly specifies where to stylize and what style to apply while preserving non-target content. At its core, GRNStyle builds on Generative Refinement Networks (GRN) and introduces a polar style-aware mask that embeds style identities as equal-norm directions within selected regions. Complementary representation--geometry conditioning combines encoded mask features with raw-mask spatial support, integrating spatiotemporal context with geometric control. To provide paired supervision, we develop an automated pipeline combining global stylization, video object removal, matting, and compositing, and construct the LociArt-100K Dataset with 100K local stylization pairs. translated_title: LociArt：自由风格局部视频风格化的统一范式
translated_abstract: 视频风格化通常对整个场景进行转换，而局部艺术编辑则需要精确的区域—风格关联、空间控制和时序一致性。我们提出LociArt，一个用于自由风格局部视频风格化的统一范式，能够明确指定在何处进行风格化以及应用何种风格，同时保留非目标内容。其核心GRNStyle构建于生成式精炼网络（Generative Refinement Networks, GRN）之上，并引入极坐标风格感知掩码，将风格身份作为等范数方向嵌入所选区域中。互补的表示—几何条件化将编码的掩码特征与原始掩码的空间支持相结合，将时空上下文与几何控制融为一体。为提供成对监督，我们开发了一条结合全局风格化、视频物体移除、抠图与合成的自动化流水线，并构建了包含10万局部风格化样本对的LociArt-100K数据集。我们进一步建立……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出LociArt统一范式，通过基于生成式精炼网络的GRNStyle与极坐标风格感知掩码，实现对局部视频区域“在哪里风格化、应用什么风格”的精确控制并保持时序一致性，同时借助自动化流水线构建了10万对样本的LociArt-100K数据集。
en_tdlr: LociArt is a unified paradigm for free-style local video stylization that uses GRNStyle with polar style-aware masks to precisely control where to stylize and what style to apply, supported by an automated supervision pipeline and the 100K-pair LociArt-100K dataset.
